description: Ciphertext-only per-recipient delivery. Never carries plaintext insight or raw telemetry.

ephemeral_public_key_b64.description: RFC4648 standard base64 of exactly 32 X25519 ephemeral public-key bytes

nonce_b64.description: RFC4648 standard base64 of exactly 12 AES-GCM nonce bytes

aad_b64.description: RFC4648 standard base64 of canonical AAD JSON (schema_version, delivery_id, event_id, resource_id, recipient_wallet, policy_version, key_epoch)

ciphertext_b64.description: RFC4648 standard base64 of AES-GCM ciphertext (includes auth tag)
